slides.title: Movie night debate
slides.text: After the movie, Will and Isla go to a cafe and talk about it for an hour. Will loved the story and the acting. Isla liked the music but thought the ending was boring. They disagree, but they respect each other's opinion. At the end they give the movie three stars.
slides.pt: Dois amigos debatem o filme e chegam a três estrelas.
